data.name: Sample - Microsoft Purview eDiscovery - 1.0.0
data.description: Sample playbooks for the "Microsoft Purview eDiscovery" connector. If you are planning to use the sample playbooks in your environment, ensure that you clone those playbooks and move them to a different collection, since the sample playbook collection gets deleted during connector upgrade and delete.

workflows.name: EDiscovery Multi Mailbox Search and Triage
workflows.description:
One playbook for the "these mailboxes may hold the phishing campaign" report: it finds or opens the Purview eDiscovery case by name, adds the reported users as custodians with legal hold, adds each new custodian's mailbox and OneDrive as data sources, creates the KQL search over those sources, waits for the estimate statistics to finish, and then asks a human to choose the response through a manual-input card that shows exactly how many items matched. Soft purge moves the matched items to the recoverable items folder, hard purge deletes them permanently, export packages them for download, and "no action" keeps the case and the search for review in the Purview portal. The search created by this run is deleted again on the way out (a reused search is kept), and the run's outcome is written back onto the reported incident when one was supplied.
Why find-or-create on both the case and the search: re-runs over the same incident must not pile up duplicate cases or duplicate searches. Both adopt an existing resource by exact display name first and record whether this run created it; the cleanup step only deletes a search this run created, so a pre-existing search definition survives every run.
Why create_custodians (the bulk op) instead of one call per user: the op matches each address against the case's existing custodians first, so a re-run reports those as already present instead of failing on the duplicate, and one bad address never aborts the batch - its failure is captured on that address's own result row.
Why the estimate runs through wait_for_search_statistics: a fresh search has no statistics until an estimateStatistics action finishes, and the counts are the whole point of the triage - the op kicks the estimate when the search has none and polls until it is done, so the card never shows zeros from an estimate that is still running.
Inputs: case_name (the eDiscovery case to find or open - default "Phishing incident response"), user_upns (comma-separated custodian UPNs, which are their SMTP addresses in the common case - default alice@contoso.example, bob@contoso.example), kql_query (the Keyword Query Language search - default subject:"payroll update", the same campaign the Purge Reported Phishing Mail scenario sweeps for), search_display_name (the search to find or create; the default adds a timestamp so concurrent runs never collide), purge_choice (soft, hard, export or none - a preselected choice for unattended runs; none, the default, asks the analyst), incident_id (optional FortiSOAR incident id to write the outcome back onto), approver (Teams recipient for the response card - default soc-oncall@contoso.example). Outputs: outcome (purged_recoverable, purged_permanent, exported, no_action or no_hits), case_id, case_auto_created, search_id, search_auto_created, action, indexed_items, unindexed_items, total_items, mailboxes, sites, operation_id, export_files, download_url.
Live prerequisites: the connector configured with eDiscovery.ReadWrite. All admin consented and a tenant licensed for Purview eDiscovery (Premium); the run needs the case-management role for create_case. The manual-input card is delivered through the "Microsoft Teams" external channel (the wiring the FortiSOAR-for-Microsoft-Teams solution pack uses); the picklist IRI is tenant-local, so it is selected on the prompt after cloning - the choice routing itself is channel-agnostic.

steps.name: Analyst Gate
steps.description:
{{ vars.stats_summary }}

Case "{{ vars.case_name }}" ({{ vars.case_id }}), query {{ vars.kql_query }}. Choose the response:
soft purge - matched items move to the mailbox's recoverable items folder (recoverable during the retention window);
hard purge - matched items are permanently deleted (Teams messages are always permanently deleted);
export - the matched items are packaged for download (PST);
no action - the case and the search stay as they are for review in the Purview portal.

At most 100 items per location are purged, and the search itself is removed again on the way out unless it existed before this run.

Wait Hard Purge -> Mark Hard Purge

No Hits Cleanup -> Record Case File

groups.name: Note: List Cases
groups.description: Every case, all pages. The match below is by exact display name, so the list has to be complete for the find-or-create to be safe.

groups.name: Note: Find Case
groups.description: Bracket access for the items key: a bare .items resolves to the dict method of the same name and the render dies on it.

groups.name: Note: Adopt Case
groups.description: The case already exists; this run must not close or delete it, only work inside it. case_auto_created stays false so the close-out can say the case was reused.

groups.name: Note: Add Custodians
groups.description: A custodian UPN is their SMTP address in the common case; for tenants where the UPN differs from the mailbox address, pass the SMTP addresses. apply_hold_to_sources starts the legal hold with the creation, which is what a phishing triage wants - the evidence must not be auto-deleted by retention while the search runs.

groups.name: Note: Find Search
groups.description: Bracket access for the items key: a bare .items resolves to the dict method of the same name and the render dies on it.

groups.name: Note: Adopt Search
groups.description: A search with this exact name already exists in the case - reuse it and its query as-is. search_auto_created stays false, which is what keeps the cleanup step from deleting it at the end of the run.

groups.name: Note: Create Search
groups.description: dataSourceScopes none: the search must look at EXACTLY the custodian sources bound below, not all case custodians or the whole tenant. The connector expands each custodian id to that custodian's existing userSources and siteSources and binds them through custodianSources@odata.bind.

groups.name: Note: No Action
groups.description: The analyst chose to change nothing: the case and the search stay available for review in the Purview portal, and only a search this run created is removed again.

groups.name: Note: Mark No Hits
groups.description: The estimate is done and it matched nothing: no card is sent, nothing is purged or exported. The zero-hit answer is itself the triage result - it usually means the campaign text never reached these mailboxes. The item counts are pinned to zero here so the close-out agrees with the outcome (the mailbox/site counts stay as the estimate reported them - an in-scope mailbox with no hits is the normal shape).
